properties.title: Ammertenhütte
properties.description:
Private hut with 6 beds on the mountain path from Lenk to the Ammerten Pass. Unstaffed. The hut was renovated in early summer 2022. Cooking facilities (firewood provided) including kitchen equipment. Water from a spring (not drinkable). Basic toilet. No electricity, mobile phone reception available. Bookings not accepted.
Prices: Overnight stay per person including firewood 20.–, payable in cash in the collection box or via Twint. Further information: Silvan Allemann 079 240 64 91 / sieben_brunnen@hotmail.com Please ensure you secure the door properly after leaving (to keep out sheep). Please take your rubbish with you and use a hut sleeping bag.
